# crosswork_l2vpn_evpn_route_type_sets (Data Source)

This data source can read an L2VPN EVPN route type set.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "crosswork_l2vpn_evpn_route_type_sets" "example" {
  id   = "cwtest-l2-route-types"
  name = "cwtest-l2-route-types"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The id of the object
- `name` (String) Name of the EVPN route type set. Any ASCII character except `%`, `?` and `#`.

### Optional

- `instance` (String) Select an instance of the provider configuration by its name. Leave it unset to use the default instance.

### Read-Only

- `evpn_route_type` (Set of Number) EVPN route types of the set, 0 to 11
